summary: Rebuild #2 of M2-S02 (access step: permission sets and permission set groups for Tier 1, Tier 2 and Billing), triggered by reports/MOCK-DEPLOY-M2.md run 1 finding F-15: the org rejected all four PermissionSet files with 'Description: data value too large ... (max length=255)', and the three PermissionSetGroup files cascaded ('permission set names are invalid') as a consequence. Rewrote only the <description> element of Case_Agent_Core.permissionset-meta.xml, Case_Billing.permissionset-meta.xml, Case_Tier1.permissionset-meta.xml and Case_Tier2.permissionset-meta.xml to 192/183/193/199 characters respectively (all <=200, clearing both the 255-char ERROR and the 200-char WARN); moved the trimmed rationale into deploy-order.md under 'Rebuild #2 -- descriptions'. No PSG file needed editing: all three PermissionSetGroup descriptions (187/194/132 chars) were already under 200. Every non-description element of the four permission sets is byte-identical to the first pass (confirmed by targeted description-only edits and file hashes recorded in deploy-order.md). All three cited skills' checkers plus check-outputs exit 0 with no DESC finding on any M2-S02 file.
confidence_rationale: Every emitted element traces to the unchanged first-pass inventory (no new element or enum was introduced); all three cited checkers exited 0 on the first repair pass; check-outputs is ok; nothing was written outside artefacts/M2-S02/; the only ambiguity (Q13, Tier1/Tier2 consolidation) was already recorded in the first pass and is unaffected by this rebuild.

process_observations.observation: The three cited skills' checkers (permission-set-architecture v1.2.0, permission-set-group-composition v1.1.0, permission-sets-vs-profiles v1.2.0) now enforce the exact 255-char Metadata API ceiling that produced F-15, with a 200-char WARN as headroom, so a description-length defect of this shape cannot reach a mock deploy again for these three skills.

check_permission_set_architecture.py at build scope still surfaces the pre-existing WARN on M2-S01's Case_Intake_Integration.permissionset-meta.xml (244 chars), a step that passed the first mock deploy by luck under the old checker and is now flagged, though fixing it is out of this step's scope.

None of the three checkers' description-length rule is cross-referenced against the Profile.description limit the deploy report also names, so a future skill whose worked example still carries a long description and no length rule would reproduce this exact deploy-time failure for that metadata type.

Q13 (Support record type for Billing) remains DEFERRED; Case_Billing keeps the conservative reading under assumption A1, carried forward unchanged from the first pass since a description edit is exactly where it could have been silently resolved and was not.
M2-S02's existing tested and documented run records predate this rebuild and F-15, so the step needs to be re-tested against the new descriptions before its tested status is trustworthy again.
process_observations.followup_reason: Re-run the step's molecular tests against the rebuilt descriptions before the step's tested status is trusted again.

process_observations.observation: The workbook rows and decisions.md entries this step's first pass produced quote the old, now-rewritten descriptions and should be refreshed once M2-S02 and M2-S03 are both rebuilt and re-tested.
process_observations.followup_reason: Refresh the workbook and decision rows that still quote the pre-rebuild descriptions.
